mobbin:2c5ec636-6d46-416e-b798-ae09d5188.summary: From a Companies list, user uploads invitees.csv, maps columns, reviews values, previews create-vs-update counts for Companies and People, confirms, and completes an import that can create or update records.
steps: Map columns — attribute pickers + sample preview
steal: 4-step stepper with dedicated Review values before Preview (steps 1–4).
Preview banner '+ N will be created' / 'N will be updated' with row-level + icons (steps 6–7) — makes merge vs create explicit before commit.
Multi-object tabs (Companies / People) from one CSV (steps 6–7, 10).
Upload step shows columns found / rows found before mapping (step 2).
avoid: Mapping Last Name→Domains in the demo path creates avoidable type errors; keep mapping defaults conservative for Essentials field types.
mobbin:2c5ec636-6d46-416e-b798-ae09d5188.fit: Strong template for Excel master-file → events: column map, value review, create/update preview, then bulk write — extend with session matching key (e.g. room+datetime or external ID).

mobbin:535a7828-5915-47a2-b782-c6bfd708a.summary: On Review values, user fixes Invalid domain errors and missing Categories inline (edit, add value, map to existing, or bulk-create select options) before continuing to Preview.
steal: Orange dots on columns that still need review (all steps) — triage without a downloadable error report.
'Needs review N' grouped unique values with row counts (steps 1–5).
Inline fix: type valid value, + Add domain/value, or pick existing option; skip/ignore per value (steps 2–8).
'+ Create N missing select options' bulk action for enum fields (steps 5–6).
mobbin:535a7828-5915-47a2-b782-c6bfd708a.fit: Best pattern for sim-center Excel imports where rooms/groups/scenarios as select fields often introduce new option values — resolve inline before creating sessions.
